data: Binance USD-M /fapi/v1/klines 4h and 1d; 2024-01-01 through 2026-10-31 UTC; raw SHA256; 2023 warmup if available; GAP never interpolated
trigger: 4h CLOSED bar breakout previous 120 contiguous 4h highs for LONG, lows for SHORT. Enter next 4h OPEN; one trade per symbol
swing: Last fractal pivot 2-left+2-right confirmed at close pivot+2, based only on previous bars
stop: Swing extremum +/-1.75 Wilder ATR(14,4h); short symmetric
chop: Previous 2190 fully-closed 4h ATR14/close values, nearest-rank P20; AND previous 180 4h high-low range / previous close <0.15. Need 365d full history; else skip
runner: +1R favorable excursion triggers BE+fees starting next bar and removes +2R TP; before state change initial TP +2R. Stop-first on same-bar collision, fill gap at adverse opening price
exit: Runner stop or close beyond last confirmed 4h fractal swing; settle open positions at last eligible close
position_sizing: Decimal quantity based on modeled per-unit stop and both fees/slip; cap 15x current realized portfolio equity
series: 6 concurrent positions and reserved stop risk <=10% equity; SKIPPED_BUDGET on violation, alpha symbol order
verdict: PF>1.3 both risks, >=60 trades, DD<=30%, top5 profit share<60%, 2024 and 2025-2026 nonnegative; LOTTERY PF<=1.0 or <30 or kill touch or <=3 explain gross profit; else GRAY
note: No parameter adaptation after observing results. Entry is an alarm, not proven edge. No live trading.
